RytmRandomizer passive controller brain mapping report
Controller profile: generic-16-encoder-performance
Label: Generic 16-Encoder Performance Brain
Controller family: generic-16-encoder
Layout: 4x4 encoders with paged intent mappings
Encoder slots per page: 16
Safety summary: passive mapping only; translates controller gestures into reviewed RytmRandomizer intent, not active MIDI sends

Pages:

Safety:
- controller_input: False
- dispatches_websocket_commands: False
- mutates_hardware: False
- opens_ports: False
- passive: True
- sends_midi: False

Blocked active actions:
- open MIDI controller input
- MIDI learn or raw CC capture
- send controller feedback
- open Analog Rytm output
- open Analog Four output
- arm hardware
- send hardware MIDI
- mutate a snapshot
- dispatch Cockpit WebSocket commands
Source: rytm_randomizer.reports.controller_mapping_profile_catalog
In-memory only: True
